CustomField.formula:
IF( TotalAllowanceValue__c < 0, "(", "") & "$" &
IF(ABS(TotalAllowanceValue__c) >= 1000000, TEXT(FLOOR(ABS(TotalAllowanceValue__c) / 1000000)) & ",", "") &
IF(ABS(TotalAllowanceValue__c) >= 1000, RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR(ABS(TotalAllowanceValue__c) / 1000)), 3) & ",", "") &
RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR(ABS(TotalAllowanceValue__c))), 3) & "." &
IF(MOD(ABS(TotalAllowanceValue__c) , 1) * 100 < 10, "0" & TEXT(ROUND(MOD(ABS(TotalAllowanceValue__c) , 1), 2) * 100), TEXT(MIN(ROUND(MOD(ABS(TotalAllowanceValue__c) , 1), 2) * 100, 99))) &
IF(TotalAllowanceValue__c < 0, ")", "")
CustomField.label: Total Allowance
